key_insight: GenEHR is a generative EHR model that learns patient trajectories over irregular time intervals and can be adapted to stratify pan-cancer risk.
clinical_relevance: In retrospective testing across five large EHR cohorts, it improved prediction of first cancer diagnosis within five years and may help prioritize patients for risk-based screening.
method: Autoregressive generative modeling of longitudinal electronic health records
Explicit modeling of irregular gaps between visits
Parameter-efficient supervised adaptation for pan-cancer risk stratification
evidence_signal: The abstract reports substantial performance gains in five large EHR cohorts for predicting first cancer diagnosis within a five-year horizon.
watch_item: Results are retrospective, so prospective validation is needed before using the model for real-world screening decisions.
paper_title: Generative model of patient health states and pan-cancer risk stratification
